entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Step-by-step instructions for everyday tasks (making a sandwich, brushing teeth); that if instructions are wrong or missing, things go wrong; computers follow instructions exactly
entries.description_zh: 日常任务可以拆成明确的步骤，例如做三明治或刷牙；步骤错误或遗漏可能导致结果出错，而计算机会严格按照指令执行。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Follow and describe algorithms that include a sequence of steps, branching (a decision such as 'if it is raining, take an umbrella') and iteration (repeating steps, such as 'hop 3 times')
entries.description_zh: 按照顺序执行步骤，并认识条件分支（如下雨就带伞）和重复执行（如跳三次）。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 我的第一个图形化程序
entries.description_en: Implement a simple algorithm as a visual (block-based) program — a start event, a sequence of blocks, run and observe — in an environment such as Scratch, ScratchJr or a programmable robot app, including short sequences that act out a maths situation (e.g. jumps along a number line)
entries.description_zh: 使用积木式编程环境，把简单算法变成可运行的程序，并观察执行结果。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Test visual programs by predicting what should happen, running them, finding where the behaviour differs (bugs) and fixing them one change at a time
entries.description_zh: 先预测程序运行结果，再测试、发现错误，并逐项修改。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Write, read, run and alter block-based code in which two or more scripts or characters run at the same time (concurrent events, e.g. started by the same event), predicting and testing the combined outcome and distinguishing it from steps that run one after another
entries.description_zh: 理解两个或多个程序脚本同时运行，与依次运行的区别，并预测组合结果。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 程序中的条件判断与输入
entries.description_en: Use input (key presses, mouse clicks, sensors or typed answers) and branching blocks (if ... then, if ... then ... else) with comparison operators to make a visual program respond to the user
entries.description_zh: 利用键盘、鼠标、传感器等输入和条件分支，让程序回应使用者。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Use loop blocks in a visual program to repeat actions a set number of times, forever, or until a condition is true, and identify where a loop makes a program shorter
entries.description_zh: 使用循环重复动作，理解固定次数、无限重复及满足条件前重复的不同形式。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Write, run, read and alter code (block-based or text-based) that places one loop inside another (for example a loop that draws a square, repeated with a turn after each square to make a rotating pattern), predict how many times the inner steps run altogether (outer repeats × inner repeats), and describe how changing the inner or the outer loop changes the outcome
entries.description_zh: 理解循环里面再放循环，计算内层步骤总执行次数，并观察修改循环后的变化。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Create and use variables in visual programs to store and change values — such as a score, a timer, a counter or a user's answer — and use them in conditions
entries.description_zh: 用变量保存和改变分数、计时器、计数器等数值，并用于条件判断。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 日常生活中的人工智能
entries.description_en: Recognise AI-enabled features in everyday life, such as face recognition, video recommendations, predictive text, speech recognition and translation, using information about the particular system rather than assuming that every automatic response uses AI.
entries.description_zh: 认识人脸识别、推荐内容、语音识别和翻译等可能使用人工智能的功能，但不能把所有自动回应都当成人工智能。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: What a robot really is — not the sci-fi version; robots in factories, robot vacuum cleaners, robot arms in surgery; that robots follow instructions given by people
entries.description_zh: 认识工厂、扫地和医疗等场景的机器人，了解机器人按照人类设计的指令工作。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Sorting objects into 'smart' (can sense and respond) and 'not smart' (just sits there); a toaster vs a smart speaker; introduction to the idea that some machines can sense and respond to the world
entries.description_zh: 比较能感知环境并作出回应的设备，与没有这类能力的普通物品。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_en: Voice Assistants and How They Work
entries.description_en: What happens when you talk to Alexa, Siri, or Google Assistant; they listen, try to understand, look up answers; sometimes they get it wrong; they are tools, not alive
entries.description_zh: 认识语音助手接收声音、尝试理解和寻找答案的过程，也知道它们可能出错，并不是生命。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: How recommendation systems work: YouTube, Netflix, and shop websites track what you click and find patterns; filter bubbles; the difference between helpful suggestions and manipulation
entries.description_zh: 认识网站如何根据点击记录推荐内容，以及推荐的便利、局限和潜在操纵。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 电脑游戏中的人工智能
entries.description_en: How computer game characters 'decide' what to do; simple rule-based AI vs learning AI; NPCs, difficulty adjustment; AI as the opponent in chess or board games
entries.description_zh: 认识游戏角色的行为规则、非玩家角色和难度调整，并比较规则式与学习式人工智能。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 人工智能的错误与局限
entries.description_en: Machines make mistakes; they only know what they've been shown; bad training data leads to bad results; AI is not magic — just maths on data; showing edge cases and failures
entries.description_zh: 了解人工智能可能因为训练数据不足或偏差而出错，并非无所不能。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 人类与机器的能力比较
entries.description_en: Comparing human and machine capabilities: creativity, empathy, common sense vs speed, memory, repetition; the Turing Test (simplified); what makes humans unique
entries.description_zh: 比较人类和机器在创造力、同理心、常识、速度、记忆与重复任务上的不同优势。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: How machine learning works at a conceptual level: show the computer many examples, it finds patterns, then it makes predictions about new things; hands-on experience with Teachable Machine or similar tool
entries.description_zh: 通过大量例子寻找规律，再利用规律对新事物作出预测。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Humans are great at spotting patterns; computers can learn to spot patterns too, but they need lots of examples; sorting and classification activities as the basis of machine learning
entries.description_zh: 认识人和电脑都能寻找规律，并通过分类活动理解机器学习需要例子。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 人工智能的数据收集与隐私
entries.description_en: What data AI systems collect about you; who has it and why it matters; cookies, tracking, smart speakers always listening; your data is valuable
entries.description_zh: 了解人工智能系统可能收集哪些个人数据、谁会使用这些数据，以及隐私为何重要。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 深度伪造与人工智能生成内容
entries.description_en: Deepfakes, AI-generated images and text; how to spot them and why they matter; the importance of checking sources; not everything online is real
entries.description_zh: 认识人工智能生成的图像、文字和伪造内容，学习核查来源，避免轻信网络信息。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Whether AI should make important decisions about people: jobs, loans, justice; who is responsible when AI makes unfair decisions; introduction to algorithmic fairness
entries.description_zh: 讨论人工智能参与招聘、贷款等重要决策时的公平问题与责任归属。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: AI needs huge amounts of energy and water to train; data centres and their environmental cost; but AI can also help — predicting weather, monitoring deforestation, optimising energy; trade-offs
entries.description_zh: 认识人工智能训练和运行的能源、水资源消耗，以及其在环境保护中的潜在用途。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_en: AI and the Future of Work
entries.description_en: How AI is changing the world of work: some jobs disappear, new ones are created, many change; jobs AI can't do (yet); what skills matter in an AI world
entries.description_zh: 认识人工智能可能改变职业与工作方式，并思考未来需要的技能。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 人工智能系统中的偏见
entries.description_en: If training data is biased, AI will be biased; examples: facial recognition working better for some skin tones, translation assuming gender; where bias comes from and whether we can fix it
entries.description_zh: 理解有偏差的训练数据可能导致不公平结果，并认识偏差来源。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 设计公平的人工智能规则
entries.description_en: Design thinking applied to AI ethics: if you were designing an AI system, what rules would you give it? Who should it help? What should it not be allowed to do?
entries.description_zh: 思考人工智能应该帮助谁、遵守什么规则，以及哪些行为不应该被允许。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: What AI might do in 10 years; what we want it to do and what we're worried about; children as future designers and decision-makers about AI; hopeful, empowered framing
entries.description_zh: 探索未来人工智能可能带来的机会与担忧，思考人类如何参与决定其发展方向。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: What data is: information that computers use — numbers, words, pictures, sounds; everything a computer knows comes from data that people give it
entries.description_zh: 认识电脑使用的数字、文字、图片和声音等数据及其来源。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.name_zh: 所有数据都可以表示为数字
entries.description_en: Explain how digital systems represent all data — text, images and sound — using numbers: each pixel's colour is stored as numbers, each letter has a number code and sound is stored as a series of number samples
entries.description_zh: 认识电脑如何以数字编码文字、图像颜色和声音采样。

entries.subject: Computing
entries.description_en: Explore how digital systems represent data using two states — on and off, written as 1 and 0 — called bits, and use binary numbers to represent whole numbers and letters
entries.description_zh: 认识电脑使用 0 和 1 两种状态表示信息，并尝试用二进制表示数字和字母。
